title: A living harbour
text:
Boats ride the swell and gulls circle over Brinehaven.

⬆️ Every boat afloat in Brinehaven now rocks and bobs gently on the water instead of sitting frozen
✨ Gulls wheel, flap and glide over the harbour
🔧 No more sea water showing inside the boats: every boat has dry floorboards laid above the waterline
⬆️ A dark line of weed and wet stone runs along the quay wall and the breakwater where they meet the sea
